Vietlook Travel will share with you the things you need to know when traveling in groups in Vietnam, please refer to it before going on a tour to have a complete discovery of the beauty of Vietnam.

The journey is for those who love taking photos, and experiencing the culture of each region, enjoying the dishes of festivals, and listening to the thrilling stories that will make tourists remember their vacation forever.

1. What is group travel?

According to Vietlook travel experience, this is a form of travel in which tourists travel with their own group, with friends or families organized on holidays to chat together.

Groups are usually about 20-30 people, or can go with less than 10 people. This form not only minimizes the risk of gathering in large groups but also brings each member the most interesting, safe and comfortable experiences.

2. Advantages of group travel in Vietnam

Save money

Finance is the most important issue that many tourists are most concerned about during their trip. If you travel alone, you must have a large amount of money in hand, so choosing to travel in a group will help you save a relatively large amount.

From transportation, food, accommodation to sleeping places, you can easily share the bill with everyone in the group. In particular, you can easily rent a cheap homestay or a private villa with a spacious, airy space to chat together.

The fun of traveling in a group

The advantage of traveling in a group in Vietnam is that it creates a lively atmosphere while playing together, and having a friend means more fun. When traveling in a group, everything you do is with your companion, so you will feel more fun during your trip, and will have the most unforgettable memories.

Someone takes pictures for you

If you go in a group when you want to save the best moments you can save them yourself with your friends, if you like to record your friends will help you with that and you will have an album to post when you feel like it.

Disadvantages of traveling in groups

If you travel in a group, the disadvantages are rare, especially when traveling to Vietnam with services that ensure the safety of passengers first, so you can freely visit and explore the most interesting things during your vacation.

Traveling together will help your feelings bond more strongly, sharing experiences and accompanying each other on every journey can help deepen the relationship. Exchange and learn from each other’s experiences.

Traveling together on a trip can give members the opportunity to learn, exchange, share and help each other in many issues and life experiences. Group travel will help you expand your knowledge and experience interesting things together that will make your trip more fun than ever.

Help you become more sociable

Group tours in Vietnam are a great choice for those who love to socialize, through which you will naturally become more extroverted, dynamic and lively than ever.

3. Is group travel cheaper than package tours?

This is a question that many people are interested in, especially those who are traveling to Vietnam for the first time. However, according to Vietlook Travel’s experience in traveling Vietnam, whichever form you choose depends on the service package you choose when registering for the tour.

When traveling independently, you book services at retail prices, while with a package tour, the travel agency will book services at group prices for you. Therefore, there will be some differences, but not significant. Because when traveling independently, you will follow your preferences, on the contrary, if you travel in a group or a large group with a travel agency, you will not have to book services, the travel agency will do the whole package for you.

You are responsible for your own safety when traveling independently, on the contrary, when going on a package tour from a travel agency, you will have travel insurance when registering for the tour.

In addition, when you go with a travel agency, you will also have a tour guide with you. Most of the guides are local, so they are very familiar with the terrain here and will take you to visit beautiful places, enjoy delicious food and experience the most interesting things.

4. Beautiful tourist destinations in Vietnam

Vietnam, the “S-shaped strip of land”, is a country with many famous landscapes, vibrant festivals, and not only that, Vietnam always welcomes visitors from all over the world with warm and hospitable smiles. Let’s take a look at the famous tourist attractions in Vietnam below with Vietlook Travel.

Co To Island

The most beautiful destination in every summer, with blue sea, white sand, golden sunshine, and gentle waves, besides there are also luxurious and magnificent resorts located in a prime location with a view of the sea that will bring visitors the most enjoyable feeling.

Co To attracts visitors by its pristine beauty and diverse culture, not only that, when coming to Co To, visitors can also enjoy delicious and attractive dishes, especially fresh seafood. In particular, Co To is also a destination chosen by many independent travelers.

Ly Son Island

With clear blue beaches, the most beautiful scenic spots are at dusk, visitors can stand on the top of Thoi Loi mountain to admire the peaceful scenery of the island, with green garlic fields, rows of areca trees leaning in the wind or wind graves located right next to the sea.

In addition, when coming to Ly Son Island, visitors can also enjoy local specialties such as: Banh it la gai, Ly Son garlic, Ly Son salad, sea snails, king crab, fish cakes … along with many delicious and attractive dishes and interesting things that this place brings to visitors.

Hang En

Located right in the limestone mountain complex of Phong Nha Ke Bang National Park. When visiting Hang En, visitors can light a campfire under the sparkling starry sky among thousands of flying swallows. The ideal time to explore the beauty of Hang En is around July.

Hang En always brings many attractive things, a destination for tourists who love to explore and experience new things. Coming here, visitors will encounter a wild, peaceful beauty.

Suoi Nuoc Moọc

A clear stream that nature has bestowed upon Quang Binh, the most beautiful place to come here is in the summer, surrounded by rocky mountains, rows of cool green trees, below is a clear stream, a stop chosen by many tourists when they have the opportunity to set foot in Quang Binh.

Located in the valley of limestone cliffs along the Chay River, Suoi Nuoc Moọc appears like a charming landscape painting. Coming here, you can experience many adventurous games, or soak in the cool water from nature.

Binh Thuan

When talking about Binh Thuan tourism, tourists often think of the beaches in Mui Ne or Phan Thiet, but you may not know that this place also has many beautiful and pristine beaches that attract tourists, very suitable for summer tours to Vietnam.

When traveling to Binh Thuan, tourists not only immerse themselves in the clear blue water of the ocean, but also admire the steep cliffs and poetic scenery, so Binh Thuan is becoming the most interesting tourist destination for your group tour when exploring the beauty of Vietnam.

Hon Dau Resort

Hon Dau Resort is located about 10km from the intersection of Highway 5B and Pham Van Dong Street, 1 hour drive from Hanoi. Coming here, you will feel like you are entering the sea gate, enjoying the cool breeze blowing in from the sea, which will bring visitors the most enjoyable feeling.

This place has a harmonious beauty between the beauty of the land, sky and sea. With lakes, green trees, the space of the sea and mountains, the rows of pine trees are always green all year round, giving the village the feeling of living on the dreamy plateau of Da Lat.

Hoi An

A romantic space of the old town, with rows of yellow-painted houses, bright red lanterns, is a destination that many tourists come to visit and sightsee. If you travel in a group, visit Hoi An to take beautiful pictures, enjoy delicious food with friends and admire the town.

5. Things to note when traveling in groups?

Choose the right companion: Group members should agree on the cost, destination, and hotel before departure to have the most perfect tour.

Plan your spending carefully, then agree on a destination with a suitable cost, choose a time that suits your work, then book air tickets and accompanying services if you travel independently. If it is peak season, you should proactively book services in advance to avoid running out of rooms, affecting your trip.

So, please choose a tour that suits your time and budget. If you are wondering about your upcoming trip to Vietnam, please contact Vietlook Travel immediately for advice on how to choose the most suitable tour for you.
